issues: No measurement circumvention: no file or network access, no hardcoded coordinates; _mc_candidate builds its packing by seeded Monte Carlo compression starting from the incumbent's own _two_phase output.
The MC result replaces the incumbent only if its radii sum is strictly larger, and it is scored and refined by the existing _score/_slsqp_refine, so validity is unchanged.
The box-resize acceptance rule is a rough compression trick rather than a proper pressure ensemble (P grows by 1.01 per sweep). That makes it less effective, not invalid.
T0 is set before _mc_candidate, so its up to 30 s comes out of the later optimisation's time budget; it still finishes within the 5-minute limit.
Candidate -2.636 equals the incumbent's -2.636 exactly, so there is no improvement; with n=1 each there is no variance estimate and z is 0 because the difference is 0. Reject is appropriate.
